comments: This tool is one component of Cluesia, a broader EU Accessibility Act (EAA) and Germany's BFSG compliance platform for e-commerce websites (https://cluesia.com). Cluesia also offers a paid, full-site WCAG 2.1 AA / EN 301 549 automated scan and monitoring subscription.
features: Free colour contrast checker. Enter a text colour and background colour to get the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio, checked against AA and AAA thresholds for normal text, large text, and UI components/graphics (criterion 1.4.3). No signup required.
title: Cluesia Colour Contrast Checker
